text: SitRep64 Tableau 6: 722 in isolation at end of day at 85.9% global bed occupancy (722/841 beds); Ituri 78.0% (548/700), Nord-Kivu 123.4% (174/141) on a capacity reported again this cycle after being absent on 16/07. Haut-Uele and Tshopo report ND, so Tshopo leaves the occupancy table rather than being carried at a stale rate. The bed identity closes exactly at every level (721 J-1 + 119 admissions - 118 exits = 722; Ituri 542 + 86 - 80 = 548; Nord-Kivu 179 + 33 - 38 = 174). Exits over 24h (118 total): 19 deaths, 56 non-cases, 32 recoveries, 11 escapes. The confirmed/suspect split is the one part that does not close (252 + 460 = 712 against the 722 census, and Nord-Kivu 17 + 155 = 172 against its own 174); the census is promoted and the residual carried on suspects at 470. Ituri first-line personnel: 119 cumulative infections, 61 recovered, 22 hospitalized, 36 deaths (CFR 30.3%), with no new infection reported on 17/07.

text: 86 new confirmed cases (Ituri 75, Nord-Kivu 7, Haut-Uele 4) and 29 new deaths (Ituri 25, Nord-Kivu 4); DRC cumulative 2267 confirmed / 893 deaths (CFR 39.4%). New confirmations rose sharply from 56 to 86, the largest single-cycle case count of the outbreak so far, while Ituri's alert-investigation rate continued recovering to 90.9% from 68.9% and 28.1% two cycles ago. The case rise tracks the third consecutive cycle of widening detection capacity, so it measures how much of the outbreak is being seen rather than establishing re-acceleration.

text: Contact follow-up rose to 83.64% nationally (9886/11820) from 66.9%, but the population under follow-up fell by 1751 in a single cycle with no explanation in the source. The coverage gain is a joint numerator-and-denominator movement and is not read as a transmission improvement. Ituri reached 83.0% (7192/8660) and Nord-Kivu 87.0% (2618/3008); Haut-Uele reports no rate at all, and the province rows sum exactly to the national totals for the first time in several cycles.

text: No new health zone was affected: the roster holds at 46 touched and 45 actively transmitting, with Miti-Murhesa (Sud-Kivu) at day 52 without a confirmed case.
